title: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning for Large Reasoning Models
paper_type_zh: 大推理模型强化学习综述
best_for_zh: 选择推理训练数据、验证信号或 RL 后训练设计的读者。
one_line: A TsinghuaC3I survey of the reinforcement-learning machinery that turns language models into reasoning models.
系统整理大推理模型强化学习、训练资源、奖励与应用的清华综述。
why: It makes reward construction, rollouts, optimization, and evaluation visible as separate data decisions.
inclusion_reason: A 2025 TsinghuaC3I survey directly connecting reasoning data, rewards, verifiers, RL post-training, and large reasoning models.

title: Problem
问题
html: Reinforcement learning has become a central way to train large reasoning models, yet a reported gain can depend on far more than the optimizer. It can depend on the tasks used for rollouts, the reward or verifier, filtering, compute budget, and evaluation. This survey gathers those pieces so readers can see RL reasoning as a data-and-feedback system rather than a named algorithm.
强化学习已成为训练大推理模型的核心方式，但一次提升远不只取决于优化器。它还取决于 rollout 所用任务、奖励或验证器、过滤、计算预算和评测。该综述把这些部件汇集起来，让读者把 RL 推理看作数据与反馈系统，而非一个算法名称。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper organizes the field through foundations, core problems, training resources, and applications. That sequence is useful: an RL method is not understandable until the data source and feedback contract are known, and a reward result is not portable until the target task and rollout conditions are known.
论文通过基础、核心问题、训练资源和应用来组织领域。这个顺序很有用：不了解数据来源和反馈约定，就无法理解 RL 方法；不了解目标任务和 rollout 条件，奖励结果就无法迁移。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a literature synthesis. For each primary method, record the prompt distribution, rollout procedure, reward or verifier, policy update, filtering rule, and evaluation set. Then separate a change to supervision from a change to sampling or inference budget. This avoids assigning every gain to RL when the training data may have changed at the same time.
这是文献综合。对每个原始方法记录提示分布、rollout 过程、奖励或验证器、策略更新、过滤规则和评测集；再分开看监督改变与采样或推理预算改变。这样不会在训练数据同时改变时，把所有提升都归因于 RL。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official abstract explicitly covers foundational components, core problems, training resources, and downstream applications after DeepSeek-R1. It is a strong index for locating source papers and resource lists. It does not make different reward functions or benchmark scores directly comparable; those studies use different tasks, feedback, and budgets.
官方摘要明确覆盖 DeepSeek-R1 之后的基础组件、核心问题、训练资源和下游应用。它是定位原始论文与资源列表的强索引，却不能让不同奖励函数或基准分数直接可比，因为研究使用不同任务、反馈和预算。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier RL summaries often treated language models broadly. This survey centers on the reasoning-model era and places training resources beside algorithms. That is important because synthetic problems, verifiable answers, process feedback, and self-generated rollouts produce different learning signals even when the optimizer name is unchanged.
较早的 RL 总结常笼统讨论语言模型；该综述聚焦推理模型时代，并把训练资源放在算法旁边。这很重要，因为合成题、可验证答案、过程反馈和自生成 rollout 即使使用相同优化器名称，也会产生不同学习信号。

title: Limitations
局限
html: RL claims are sensitive to hidden choices. A noisy reward can optimize fluent but invalid traces, a weak verifier can reward shortcuts, and more rollouts can imitate algorithmic progress. The survey cannot normalize those conditions across all primary work. Before reuse, inspect reward failures, rollout count, and whether evaluation overlaps with training tasks.
RL 主张对隐藏选择很敏感。噪声奖励可能优化流畅但无效的过程，弱验证器可能奖励捷径，更多 rollout 也可能伪装成算法进步。综述无法统一所有原始研究的条件。复用前应检查奖励失败、rollout 数量，以及评测是否同训练任务重叠。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this survey when designing a reasoning post-training loop. Start by writing the task distribution and terminal predicate, then choose the reward, verifier, rollout budget, and policy update. Measure answer correctness and feedback quality separately. This turns “use RL” into a reproducible sequence of data decisions.
设计推理后训练循环时可用这篇综述。先写任务分布和终止判定，再选择奖励、验证器、rollout 预算和策略更新；分开测量答案正确性与反馈质量。这样“使用 RL”就变成一串可复现的数据决策。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the training-resource sections before the algorithm list. Make one record per method with data, feedback, update, budget, and result. The key reading habit is to ask which component supplies the learning signal. That question is more informative than asking only whether the method uses PPO, GRPO, or another named update.
先读训练资源部分，再读算法列表。每个方法做一条记录：数据、反馈、更新、预算和结果。关键阅读习惯是追问学习信号由哪个部件提供。这比只问方法使用 PPO、GRPO 还是其他命名更新更有信息。
